# SDU Withdraws From War With Hawazan

The SDU has announced its full withdrawal from the war with Hawazan, saying its strategic goal has been achieved.

"We are fully withdrawing from the war with Hawazan, as our strategic goal has been achieved," an SDU representative said in a statement.

The SDU had been fighting Hawazan as part of the UDC coalition. Its exit leaves the UDC, the Vollachian Empire, GOC, the Army of Christ Our Lord and one other faction still listed as fighting Hawazan. The SDU didn't say what its strategic goal was.

We'll update this story as it develops.
